name: Evelyn Regner - Après le considérant 1 - Am 82
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text: (1 a) In 1975, the Commission tabled a proposal to minimise the differences between Member States' corporate tax rates. Under the proposal, Member States could still choose their own corporate tax rate, but that rate could “not be lower than 45 % nor higher than 55 %”. Due to a lack of support from Member States, the proposal was withdrawn.
